title: Rearrange digits from largest to smallest
summary: A numeric utility rearranges the digits of a nonnegative integer to form the largest possible number. Return the resulting integer, keeping repeated digits. Return the number obtained by sorting its decimal digits in descending order.
requirements: Input is a nonnegative safe integer.
Return a number, not a string.
hints: Treat the digits as characters for sorting.
Join them and convert the result back to a number.
referenceCode: export function descendingDigits(n) { return Number([...String(n)].sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a)).join('')); }
